name: diagnostic-platform-monorepo
description: Healthcare Diagnostic Sample Pickup and Logistics Platform

scripts.build:all: npm run build:shared && npm run build:api && npm run build:web && npm run build:functions
scripts.firebase:deploy: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace=@diagnostic/portal run build && npm run build:functions && node scripts/deploy-firebase.mjs
scripts.firebase:deploy:hosting: npm --workspace=@diagnostic/portal run build && node scripts/sync-hosting.mjs && firebase deploy --only hosting --project labsetu-diagnostics --config firebase/firebase.json
scripts.firebase:deploy:functions: npm --prefix firebase/functions run build && firebase deploy --only functions --project labsetu-diagnostics --config firebase/firebase.json

author: Vikas
